preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= n and 1 <= v <= n and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must connect valid vertices and must not connect a vertex to itself.
The number of edges must be exactly n - 1 for a valid tree.

postconditions.description: The output must start with the number of paths chosen.
Each path description must have the correct number of elements.
postconditions.expression: all(len(path) == len(edges_in_path) + 2 for path in paths_output)

postconditions.description: All distances x must be between 0 and 1.
postconditions.expression: all(0 <= x <= 1 for x in x_values)

postconditions.description: The output must minimize res1, res2, ..., resn as required by the task.
postconditions.expression: all(res[i] <= resOptimal[i] for i in range(n))

postconditions.description: Each path description must include the number of edges, the indices of the edges, the vertices u and v, and the distance x.
postconditions.expression: all(len(path) == 4 and isinstance(path[0], int) and isinstance(path[1], list) and len(path[1]) == path[0] and isinstance(path[2], tuple) and len(path[2]) == 2 and isinstance(path[3], float) and 0 <= path[3] <= 1 for path in paths_output)

postconditions.description: The selected paths must cover all vertices of the tree.
postconditions.expression: all(v in vertices_covered for v in range(1, n + 1))

postconditions.description: The selected paths must be simple and pairwise non-intersecting in edges.
